svg.title: The ecs_swarm hierarchy drawn as debug lines
svg.desc: A run-length-encoded render of the demo's headless shot: 152 debug lines run from every parented entity to its parent, converging on the sun at the centre, with short links from each moon to its planet.
svg.text: The claim, made checkable — every line is one entity's parent link.
180×129 cells of the 480×270 framebuffer, run-length encoded
printed by --shot, so this figure is checkable
the sun and the camera have no parent
is the point: a debug view whose count
you cannot derive is a debug view you
Every line converging on the middle is a ring member or a waypoint placed relative to the sun. The short ones
further out are moons, two composes deep. Press [H] and half of them vanish — which is what “detached” has
meant since Lesson 5.9, finally visible rather than asserted.
